title: Proposed extended muster_list_my_events input
description: Event listing, not MCP tools/list discovery. Preserves legacy nullable filters and limit-clamping compatibility; proposed status/projection defaults are metadata pending owner approval, not enforcement decisions.

name.description: Case-insensitive name substring. Missing or null means no name filter; an empty string retains its existing unfiltered meaning.

limit.description: Existing default 20 when missing/null. Integers above 50 remain structurally valid because the existing server clamps them to 50; do not add a schema maximum that breaks that compatibility.

cursor.description: Existing 24-character hexadecimal next_cursor, or null/missing for first page. Empty string is invalid. Server checks pagination against the applied filters.

status.description: Proposed status filter. Recommended all preserves legacy visibility; exact open/archived lifecycle interpretation and approved default belong to the owner decision.

needs_my_answer.description: Proposed own-answer filter. Server applies the approved status and owner-participation semantics before pagination; this flag does not grant access to anyone else's answer.

projection.description: Recommended full preserves legacy event/grid fields. Compact is explicit; its output contract must identify the projection rather than silently omit required full fields.
